verdict.rationale: Penpot's docs explicitly promote open standards (CSS, HTML, SVG, JSON) plus its own open file format for design inspection/export, alongside self-hosting and API/access-token routes so users fully own and can migrate their data without vendor lock-in. Community sentiment corroborates the openness value proposition (users self-host to avoid being 'held hostage in a proprietary cloud silo'). Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that full-file export (not just per-layer) works flawlessly today, since one older community report described being limited to exporting single layers rather than a full file.
